scope: frontend port with synthetic paginated projection
checks: Planning accepts 10,000 rows through bounded pages while keeping fewer than 70 DOM rows
Focus is retained outside the viewport without retaining the complete list
Keyboard moves through offscreen rows without losing the current control
Viewport resize preserves bounded rendering and does not overflow the document
Large-list teardown leaves no late callback errors

scroll.environment: headless Chromium; not a device FPS guarantee
